_meta.paired_lanes: pdb (experimental) vs pdb_as_afdb (predicted); NOT afdb, which is disjoint
_meta.ordering: confidence, the mean predicted probability across the residues that form the pocket
_meta.secondary: rank_value (mean_top8_logit), reported but not the sort
_meta.claim: ranked CANDIDATES, each with a predicted pocket and a named reachable cysteine
not_claimed: that any listed protein HAS a cryptic pocket. Protein-level detection is not licensed (about 15 public negatives exist, so no one can benchmark it)
that proteins ABSENT from this list lack cryptic pockets
any probability for a row: the threshold tau does not transfer to this population, so only within-catalogue percentiles and the held-out quartile curve are calibrated
that a pocket will OPEN on binding, which is Stage 3/6 and unrun

caveats.length_drift: Tier 1 rho(rank, n_res)=+0.285; Tier 2 -0.011 (p=0.52), absent on AlphaFold
caveats.already_open: 5.8% of audited Tier-1 pockets had a ligand within 4.5 A; 9-11% at the head
caveats.label_homology: 28.4% of Tier 1 is >=30% identical to a training protein
caveats.family: unfiltered heads concentrate in one family; the filters invert it
caveats.plddt: 36% of Tier-2 candidates below median pLDDT 70

population.why: the PDB tier was chosen by source-organism lineage including human at the entity level, which admits fusions, chimeras and mixed-species constructs whose UniProt accession is the non-human part

substitution.was: 11QE chain A (GDP-bound G12D/I55E), the structure the screen chose
substitution.why: consistency with the report, whose case study is the G12C structure
substitution.how: code/utils/kras_swap_job.py (the screen's own statistics, pocket, state and cysteine reach on 4LDJ; the same code on 11QE reproduced the stored row first) and code/md/swap_kras_row.py
substitution.not_changed: the cancer-mutation table (made on the original pockets), the identity to training proteins, the disease and chemistry fields
substitution.cysteine_note: the cysteine in reach is Cys12, created by G12C; Cys118 is 4.74 A from the pocket on 4LDJ, outside the 4.5 A gate
